description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseCustomizableMetadata' which extends 'BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata' and implements 'Customizable'. It provides support for user-defined attributes in OpenMRS metadata entities. The class manages a collection of attributes, including methods for retrieving active attributes, adding attributes, and updating attributes by type.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableMetadata
classes.description: An abstract class that supports customizable metadata entities with user-defined attributes in OpenMRS, allowing for retrieval, addition, and management of attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of all attributes associated with the entity.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns a collection of non-voided (active) attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns a list of active attributes filtered by a specific attribute type.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a new attribute to the entity and sets its owner.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Replaces or updates an attribute of a specific type, voiding existing active attributes of that type if necessary.
